title: Claude Code — Productivity
description: Code output and time saved with Claude Code.

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT if(UserEmail != '', UserEmail, UserId) FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND if(UserEmail != '', UserEmail, UserId) != '' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'added') FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}')

SELECT sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'removed') FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}')

SELECT sum(Value) FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.commit.count' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}')

SELECT sum(Value) FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.pull_request.count' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}')

panels.title: Your time
panels.description: Time developers were actively interacting (typing, reading).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'user') FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}')

panels.title: Claude time
panels.description: Time Claude Code was working (tool runs, model responses).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'cli') FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}')

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['type'] AS type, sum(Value) AS lines FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}') GROUP BY time, type ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, replaceOne(replaceOne(MetricName, 'claude_code.', ''), '.count', '') AS kind, sum(Value) AS count FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('claude_code.commit.count', 'claude_code.pull_request.count') AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}') GROUP BY time, kind ORDER BY time

panels.title: Edit suggestions accepted vs rejected
panels.description: Edit / Write / NotebookEdit permission decisions, by file language.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(Attributes['language'] != '', Attributes['language'], 'unknown') AS language, Attributes['tool_name'] AS tool, sumIf(Value, Attributes['decision'] = 'accept') AS accepted, sumIf(Value, Attributes['decision'] = 'reject') AS rejected, accepted / nullIf(accepted + rejected, 0) AS accept_rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}') GROUP BY language, tool ORDER BY accepted + rejected DESC

SELECT if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) AS user, sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'added') AS added, sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'removed') AS removed FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}') GROUP BY user ORDER BY added DESC LIMIT 20
